image_description: An interior view of a dilapidated prison cell block featuring rough, peeling plaster walls and a concrete floor. A man stands on the right side next to a broken wooden chair. To the left is an open green metal barred gate leading into a cell area. In the background, a large window with vertical iron bars allows light to enter. The scene conveys a sense of abandonment and decay rather than active security.

The peeling paint texture is somewhat repetitive and lacks the fine-grained randomness of real decay, appearing slightly 'painted on' or smudged in areas.
The vertical bars of the background window show very slight inconsistency in thickness and alignment, suggesting minor geometric warping typical of AI generation.
